'''Nyemari''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. By [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the planet's capital [[City/Legends|city]] [[Anem]] had the most modern, sophisticated spaceport in the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]]. The planet was also host to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Nyemari Imperial Military Installation|military installation]]. The indigenous species was the [[Nyemarian]]s. It was [[Mission to Nyemari|visited]] by a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operatives to steal the Duchess' access codes to the installation. After the mission, the Rebel's encounter with a [[Unidentified Glymphid messenger|mysterious messenger]] led them to [[Rezi Soresh]] in the [[Sixela system/Legends|Sixela system]].

==Description==
Nyemari was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. By [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Anem]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] capital [[City/Legends|city]], had the most modern, architecturally sophisticated spaceport in the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]]. Anem itself was a maze of skyscrapers, a veritable forest of [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] and duracrete.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic War]], the planet descended into a [[civil war]] which caused several [[Nyemarian]] to flee despite the sect vowing to kill all deserters.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Under Threat of Death}}</ref>

In 1 ABY, [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] leader [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and her [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|companions]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] [[Mission to Nyemari|infiltrated]] the [[Nyemari Royal Palace|Royal Palace]] on Nyemari to steal access codes for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Nyemari Imperial Military Installation|garrison]]. The Rebels were forced to exfiltrate when Solo bumped Organa and she hit the silent alarm. Organa went off to acquire a means of escape while Skywalker and Solo hid in a closet, with the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] standing watch and blending in with the Palace guards. Organa barreled through the walls of the palace with an airspeeder with [[Laser cannon/Legends|blasters]] blazing, picking up her companions. Organa's piloting allowed them to avoid the Royal guards giving chase on [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bikes]].<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

The Rebels returned to the [[South Anem Spaceport]], where they had hid their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], with a [[Nyemarian]], [[Li Preni]], who owed Solo a favor. The man lied about meeting the [[Unidentified Glymphid messenger|Glymphid]] following the Rebels, but told the truth when Chewbacca threatened him. Thinking it was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] from [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] following them, Solo convinced the others to confront the Glymphid.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

The Rebels cornered the Glymphid following them. The Glymphid approached Skywalker and gave him a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] from former Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]] asking for Skywalker to meet him in the [[Sixela system/Legends|Sixela system]], and threatening to kill a [[Endeavor (Arkanian starship)|ship]] full of over 100 passengers if Skywalker didn't comply. As a measure of his power, Soresh had the messenger killed in front of Skywalker using some sort of activated [[Poison/Legends|poison]]. Skywalker knew he had no choice and would go alone to meet Soresh, but his companions would not let him go without backup. They then left Nyemari to meet Soresh on his [[Unidentified dead red moon|barren moon]].<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

==Inhabitants==
The planet's primary inhabitants were the [[Nyemarian]]s. The government was led by a Duchess. To the Nyemarian palace guards, all Wookiees looked the same, but the guards were not surprised to see one in the palace.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

==Locations==
The capital city was Anem, which hosted the Royal Palace. The South Anem Spaceport was located on the edge of Anem and the local [[Desert/Legends|desert]]. The Nyemari Imperial Military Installation was also located on the planet.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nyemari is a planet featuring in the final book of [[Alex Wheeler]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Force]]'' series.
